chunks: 'Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to 'Ali عليه السلام: O 'Ali, when I die, then wash me with seven waterskins from the water of the well of Ghars.

key_terms.سَبْعِ قِرَبٍ: Seven waterskins, specifying the measured amount of water
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْنِي: Wash me, referring to the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.مَاءِ بِئْرِ غَرْسٍ: The water of the well of Ghars, the particular well named in the instruction
key_terms.مِتُّ: I die, referring to the Prophet’s passing
key_terms.يَا عَلِيُّ: O 'Ali, a direct address to Imam 'Ali عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله instruct Imam 'Ali عليه السلام to use for washing his body after death?
ai.summary: This hadith records an instruction of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله to Imam 'Ali عليه السلام regarding his washing after death. It indicates a specific funerary practice connected to the Prophet’s burial rites and reflects transmitted sunnah concerning the deceased.
